features.text: THORACOLUMBAR STABILIZATION: Provides multi level spinal support for fractures, post op recovery, and chronic pain.

BREATHABLE, DURABLE BUILD: Professional grade materials support long term daily wear.
ONE SIZE ADJUSTABLE DESIGN: Fits most waists with extension options for broader coverage.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.

PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
